name: Fujiwara no Yasuhira
source:
Heir of the Oshu Fujiwara and the second son of Fujiwara no Hidehira
Also Shirogane's master and old friend of Kurou Yoshitsune and Musashibou Benkei.
A discerning and clever man and excel with onmyou arts.
His relationship with the protagonist is courteous, but there are times when he seems to cruelly push her away.

He has his own route as downloadable contents in Harukanaru toki no naka de 3 Ultimate
